screens.name: Home — unavailable omen and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 08–09 show the orb-led entry and unavailable omen; supplied runtime evidence reports reduced-motion and enlarged-text checks.
findings: Increase the visual presence of the example question above the orb so it remains useful against the mist.

screens.name: Home — successful omen fixture
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows a clearly labeled free omen beneath the primary orb, using explicitly synthetic content.
findings: Preserve readable separation between the omen and the raised Ask tab as omen text grows.

screens.name: Approach — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows consistent orb-led transition composition, and supplied evidence states automatic advancement after 650ms or immediately with reduced motion.
findings: Verify that automatic advancement produces one coherent screen-reader announcement on physical devices.

screens.name: Ask — normal and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows a labeled multiline question field, typing-to-voice alternative and distinct submit button with consistent transition placement.
findings: Replace the vague user-facing phrase “your prediction engine” with a concise explanation of where submitted information goes.

screens.name: Ask — enlarged text
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows the enlarged question, disclosure and submit action fitting in the captured viewport without the decorative orb.
findings: Verify that a physical keyboard preserves access to the submit action and its disclosure.

screens.name: Listening — voice failure and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows prominent typing recovery, a secondary voice retry and a bottom microphone-error notice; hardware voice behavior is unverified.
findings: Place the microphone failure explanation beside the typing fallback so the recovery does not depend on noticing the distant notice.

screens.name: Planning — loading and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows stage-specific loading text, a time expectation, credit reassurance and Cancel, with supplied reduced-motion evidence.
findings: Verify that cancellation and loading-stage announcements remain understandable with a physical screen reader.

screens.name: Question 1 — choices and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows four separated answer rows and numbered progress; supplied evidence reports immediate keyboard activation and focus transfer.
findings: Confirm that immediate advancement announces the next question without losing the selected answer on native assistive technology.

screens.name: Question 2 — choices and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 preserves question, answer-row and progress placement between the transition and settled second question.
findings: Verify that returning to this question exposes its previous selection through both visible and spoken feedback.

screens.name: Question 3 — choices and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows the final numbered question with the same immediate-choice treatment as earlier steps.
findings: Give a concise indication that choosing the final answer starts prediction generation.

screens.name: Question — keyboard-focused heading
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 visibly outlines the new question heading, and supplied keyboard evidence reports that Tab subsequently reaches the first answer.
findings: Make the heading focus outline visually consistent with the gold settings focus treatment while retaining clear visibility.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty, normal and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows retained question context, Your answer, Change, multiline input and a muted Continue button.
findings: Explain the empty-field requirement beside the input so the disabled Continue state has an explicit reason.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty enlarged text
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows the enlarged question, field and Continue fitting visibly without the decorative orb.
findings: Retain the question context and explicit empty-field guidance when the physical keyboard opens.

screens.name: Custom answer — filled at 200%
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows readable multiline entered text and a fully visible Reveal my prediction button at enlarged size.
findings: Verify longer answers can be reviewed and edited without obscuring the submission action on a phone.

screens.name: Custom answer — synthetic keyboard-constrained viewport
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows the entered answer and submit action but no visible question text in the captured constrained view; supplied evidence reports retained context.
findings: Demonstrate how the question context can be recovered with a physical keyboard open, since this capture does not show it.

screens.name: Research — loading and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 11–12 show research-specific status text, a bounded wait expectation and Cancel with consistent visible composition.
findings: Verify that a prolonged request supplies recovery before the stated waiting expectation becomes misleading.

screens.name: Plan error — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 shows an explicit failure, no-charge reassurance, primary retry and secondary question editing using labeled fixture copy.
findings: Verify that retry retains the original question and communicates a repeated connection failure accessibly.

screens.name: Prediction error — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 adds Review answers to the retry and edit-question recovery paths without changing their visual hierarchy.
findings: Verify preserved answers across repeated failure and recovery on a physical device.

screens.name: Reveal — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 12–13 show the speculative label, prediction, explanation disclosure, check-back date and five follow-up actions with opaque transition text.
findings: Group editing and answer-review actions below the immediate result actions to reduce the competing choices after reveal.

screens.name: Reveal — expanded Why and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows a clearly expanded disclosure followed by a dense, long-form fixture explanation extending below the viewport.
findings: Structure lengthy explanations into short labeled sections so users can scan context and assumptions without reading one continuous block.

screens.name: Check-in — unanswered and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 04–05 show Yes, Not quite and Not yet adjacent to the saved prediction, with a separate check-back date and share action.
findings: Test whether users notice the outcome prompt before the more prominent Share this glimpse button.

screens.name: Check-in — Not quite saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows inline saved status, a checkmarked Not quite choice and a confirmation notice; supplied evidence reports reload persistence.
findings: Verify that the inline status and notice do not produce duplicate screen-reader announcements.

screens.name: Check-in — Not yet saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 distinguishes a saved pending outcome with text, a selected checkmark and “Still waiting to unfold” feedback.
findings: Verify that the pending outcome remains easy to change during a later check-in.

screens.name: Check-in — Yes saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows Came true saved status and a checkmarked Yes choice, backed by reported real storage behavior on synthetic content.
findings: Verify that changing an accidentally selected outcome is discoverable without a confirmation dialog.

screens.name: History — empty and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows a concise empty state, device-local storage disclosure and an Ask the Ball action.
findings: Verify that the empty-state action has a full touch target despite its understated text-only appearance.

screens.name: History — populated and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 separates date, original question, prediction and check-back date within a borderless history row.
findings: Strengthen the row’s open affordance so readers can recognize that a saved prediction can be revisited.

screens.name: History — stress list
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows multiple separated entries with a partially visible lower row above the persistent navigation.
findings: Verify the final row scrolls completely clear of the raised Ask orb at normal and enlarged text sizes.

screens.name: History — persisted outcome
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows a checkmarked Came true status in the saved row, and supplied evidence reports outcome persistence.
findings: Keep completed and pending outcomes equally explicit when a longer mixed history is scanned.

screens.name: Sky — selected sample and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 16 shows explicit offline samples, Retry, a checkmarked selected star and a fully visible Ask this too button.
findings: Verify star targets and reading order on assistive technology because their spatial arrangement alone does not establish accessibility.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows an offline message, Retry, sharing boundaries and muted creation and permission controls; supplied evidence confirms creation is disabled.
findings: Place an explicit offline reason next to the disabled creation action so its availability is immediately clear.

screens.name: Plans — normal and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show selected annual pricing, monthly pricing, packs and repeated simulation disclosures without a decorative orb.
findings: Verify selected-plan changes are announced together with their billing period and total price.

screens.name: Plans — enlarged text
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows readable stacked annual pricing and monthly terms, while the continuation button reaches the bottom of the capture.
findings: Demonstrate complete access to the continuation button and remaining purchase information after scrolling at 200%.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect — plan and prediction fixtures with transitions
screens.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show consistent support-first layouts, alternative question actions and explicit credit and memory reassurance in labeled fixture states.
findings: Verify the support destination and safe return path before treating this recovery route as complete.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect — actual response, normal text
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows the actual safety response, prominent support action and readable explanatory guidance; external support navigation was not tested.
findings: Validate that the support action reaches an appropriate, usable destination on the target device.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect — actual response, 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 keeps the enlarged support action fully visible, while the explanatory guidance continues beyond the captured viewport.
findings: Verify that all urgent guidance remains reachable and correctly ordered under native text enlargement and screen-reader navigation.

screens.name: You — empty memory, settings and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 15 and 17 show plan status, a useful memory empty state and labeled preferences; supplied evidence reports keyboard activation and persistence.
findings: Consolidate the duplicated See plans and View plans and credits entry points if they serve the same destination.

screens.name: You — focused settings control
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 shows a visible outline around the entire Large text preference row, supported by reported 342×52px target measurements.
findings: Verify that native accessibility exposes the whole row as one labeled switch with its current state.

screens.name: You — enlarged settings controls
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows enlarged labels and tabs, with the lower Privacy and entertainment action partially visible above the fixed navigation.
findings: Verify every lower settings action can scroll fully clear of the navigation at 200% and native Dynamic Type.

screens.name: You — populated real memory
screens.evidence: Sheet 17 shows actual-flow memory facts with separate Edit and Forget actions, and supplied runtime evidence reports edit, forget and Undo.
findings: Verify repeated Edit and Forget controls announce their associated fact names on assistive technology.

screens.name: Share — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 shows a small export preview and image, video and invitation actions; PNG export is demonstrated but successful MP4 encoding is unverified.
findings: Label or disable unavailable video export before activation so users do not discover host limitations through an avoidable error.

screens.name: Story card — full preview and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 16 shows a readable full card and explicit Download image action, backed by reported successful 1080×1920 PNG export.
findings: Verify accessible text equivalents for the preview and complete access to Back to sharing below the captured fold.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: The sheets consistently use the illustrated orb as the visual anchor, with supplied browser motion and reduced-motion checks.
findings: Verify that interactive orbs have action names and decorative copies are excluded from native accessibility navigation.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Sheets 05, 07–09 and 14–17 show labeled tabs, underlined selection and a raised Ask orb, including enlarged labels.
findings: Verify enlarged labels, safe-area padding and scroll clearance together on a physical phone.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: Headers consistently pair a title or wordmark with a remaining-daily-reading count that visibly changes between states.
findings: Use “1 reading left today” where space permits to make the balance understandable outside the main reading flow.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream filled buttons provide consistent emphasis, dark labels and enlarged wrapping across input, recovery, support and export screens.
findings: Verify pressed, busy and disabled announcements on native controls as well as the demonstrated browser paths.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Gold text actions recur throughout the sheets, with several similarly weighted choices beneath the reveal and share content.
findings: Reduce adjacent equal-weight actions and verify the complete touch area around each text label.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Sheets 01–03 show roomy divided rows, and supplied evidence verifies Space/Enter activation, advancement and restored-answer labeling.
findings: Expose the final choice’s generation consequence before immediate advancement.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Sheets 01–02 show a persistent label and readable multiline text within a gold rectangle with an additional lower line.
findings: Simplify the competing outer border and inner baseline while keeping the input boundary and focus unmistakable.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Sheets 01, 04 and 05 show enlarged multiline fields and submission controls, with supplied synthetic keyboard-viewport checks.
findings: Validate caret visibility, context recovery and submission reachability with a physical keyboard and native text scaling.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheets 14–15 show positional and color state cues, a whole-row focus outline and reported 342×52px labeled targets.
findings: Confirm native switch semantics and state announcements with VoiceOver and TalkBack.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheets 08–09 show both a successful fixture omen and an explicit unavailable state with an alternative next step.
findings: Maintain sufficient clearance and contrast for longer omen content above the raised navigation orb.

components.name: Sky stars and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 16 connects a checkmarked selected category to its labeled sample question and prominent action.
findings: Verify generous invisible hit areas and a logical accessible order for the scattered star controls.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Sheet 05 states the sharing boundary and offline condition while presenting muted unavailable controls.
findings: Associate the offline explanation directly with disabled creation and distinguish it from age-restricted permissions.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheet 07 uses date gutters, question summaries, larger predictions and explicit saved outcome or check-back status.
findings: Add a restrained opening affordance and verify that each row has a concise accessible name.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show a checked annual option, total annual cost, monthly comparison and stacked enlarged pricing.
findings: Verify radio-style selection semantics and announcement of the full billing commitment.

components.name: Share preview
components.evidence: Sheets 15–16 show the same composed card at thumbnail and full-preview sizes, with speculative labeling more readable at full size.
findings: Provide a readable text equivalent or enlargement path for the thumbnail’s tiny disclosure and prediction text.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Sheets 09–10 show opaque notices with explicit messages and Dismiss, alongside inline saved-outcome feedback.
findings: Verify notices neither obscure required actions nor duplicate live-region announcements.

components.name: Typography and spacing system
components.evidence: The sheets consistently distinguish serif questions and predictions from sans-serif controls, while supplied evidence reports 14px supporting captions and sampled contrast passes.
findings: Improve the faint Home prompt and structure long expanded explanations without weakening the established type hierarchy.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: Dark mist and restrained gold illumination remain coherent across the sheets, with supplied sampled contrast, frame-timing and stopped-draw reduced-motion evidence.
findings: Confirm sustained contrast and reduced-motion behavior on native rendering and representative physical phones.

limitations: All grades are provisional: the attached screenshots were visually assessed, and runtime results are supplied evidence rather than independently rerun checks.
The authorized threshold is not met; multiple screens and components fall below 8, and no item is certified at 9 or 10.
Apply A as the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces, F as the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility, and overall as 0.4A + 0.6F; exclude null dimensions from their respective means.
No hard-gate failure is established by the supplied material; content extending below a screenshot does not itself prove an unreachable control or unreadable full screen.
Transition pairs support visual consistency, while supplied sampled frames support limited browser continuity; they do not prove every frame, native animation or screen-reader transition.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, keyboard safe areas, VoiceOver/TalkBack, microphone hardware, haptics and OS share delivery remain unverified.
Payments are simulated; social backend and authentication behavior are unavailable, and external support navigation was not performed.
PNG export is demonstrated in supplied evidence; successful MP4 output is unverified, with only recoverable encoding failure described.
Synthetic fixtures establish layout coverage only; neither those fixtures nor one actual Ollama flow establishes predictive accuracy or broad semantic quality.
The synthetic keyboard capture does not visibly show question context, despite supplied runtime evidence reporting retention; physical keyboard verification remains necessary.
topFixes: Complete physical phone and assistive-technology checks for focus transfer, text scaling, keyboard clearance, tab navigation and support access before seeking 9/10 certification.
Make video-export availability clear before activation and verify the external support destination.
Preserve discoverable question context in constrained keyboard layouts and demonstrate complete scrolling access to enlarged controls.
Reduce competing reveal actions, strengthen history-row affordance and structure long explanations for scanning.
Clarify submission-data wording, empty-input requirements and the final answer’s immediate generation consequence.
Improve the faint Home example prompt and verify that notices announce once without obscuring actions.
